NEET Long Term Residential Coaching

NEET is one of the toughest entrance exams in the country. It is the common medical entrance test for prestigious institutions such as AIIMS and JIPMER. There is fierce competition among candidates and the college cutoffs are very high. Preparation is the key and therefore, the more time you get to prepare, the better are your chances for success.

NEET long-term coaching is designed to help candidates prepare for NEET at their own pace, while covering all the topics that are likely to come. NEET long-term coaching can start as early as Class 8, 9 and 10 through foundation courses and can range from one-year program from Class 12 to two-year program from Class 11.

Benefits of Long-Term Coaching:

  • It gives candidates ample time to prepare for the exam and cover all chapters in the NEET syllabus
  • Preparing long term allows for more revision time and clearer understanding of the concepts
  • Candidates can check crucial factors such as time management, learning speed and accuracy by giving tests at regular intervals
  • Taking tests lets you know how well you’re prepared. If you score low in a test there is always an opportunity to learn from your mistakes and bounce back in the next one
  • Time is a precious commodity when it comes to exam preparation. Starting preparations well beforehand gives you time for breaks between studies to refresh your mind and focus better

NEET Repeater Residential Coaching

Repeater courses are specifically designed for those appearing for NEET or other medical entrance exams. They are offered as one or two-year programs and is based on the pattern of the entrance exam and not the board exam. Due to this, it takes a far more aggressive and focused approach towards preparation with in-depth study material and mock tests that help candidates improve time management and accuracy.

Here are Some Benefits that Repeater Courses Offer:

  • Improved NEET performance enabling admission in top colleges
  • Consistent exposure and practice with mock tests helps candidates handle exam pressure easily
  • Enhanced understanding of exam pattern provides an edge over fresher’s
  • Free from compulsion of attendance and Class 12 studies, with sole focus on NEET

IIT JEE Long Term Residential Coaching

JEE is counted among the most challenging exams in the country and is the gateway that aspiring students have to pass through to get admission in various engineering colleges including the prestigious IITs and NITs. Long-term coaching for IIT JEE exams means preparing for a minimum of 2 years or before Class 11. For example, a student in Class 11 can join a three-year course in which one year will be a foundation course followed by a two year JEE program.

Listed Below are a Few Benefits of Long-Term JEE Coaching:

  • Plenty of available time ensures less pressure and a systematic learning process
  • Students can complete all assignments and exercises at their own pace
  • Consistent practice helps them solve more problems thus boosting confidence
  • Balance between study and leisure can be maintained as there is no shortage of time
  • Students who undertake long-term JEE coaching have an edge over those who are planning for the entrance exam but not doing anything about it

IIT JEE Repeater Residential Coaching

Those JEE Main candidates who are eligible for only two attempts are known as repeaters. For aspirants such as these, there needs to be an effective study plan that streamlines their preparation and also imparts effective learning through consistent revision and a competitive environment.

Benefits of Repeater Residential Coaching:

  • Improved chances of clearing JEE and hence admission to IITs
  • No distraction as focus is on JEE preparation and not maintaining performance in Class 12
  • Constant exposure to mock tests makes the candidate handle pressure better than others
  • Aggressive syllabus that covers all important topics and chapters
